name: Obubby
look: a baby opossum with a big round white head, huge dark ears, a pink snout and blush, and a long pink tail it hugs in front of it
entry: It clings to its mother's back for weeks after it is born, hugging its own long tail when it gets scared. When something startles it, it flops over and plays dead, curl of hair and all.
how: Wild: common in forests and plains at night.
Evolves into Mumossum at level 30, and learns Joey Slingshot when it does.
